Texts.Name: PremiseLine1
Texts.Text: They say someone broke the Crown of Balance.

Texts.Name: PremiseLine2
Texts.Text: Some who picked up its shards grew a halo. Others grew horns.

Texts.Name: PremiseLine3
Texts.Text: Now each side says the other did it.
